eyebrow.zh: 新加坡 · 金融与量化金融

intro.en: I'm a Chinese international student at Singapore Management University. This is my personal website, where I show some of my projects and the things I care about: commodities, how they move around the world, and how they are priced.
intro.zh: 我是一名就读于新加坡管理大学的中国留学生。这是我的个人网站，展示我的一些项目，以及我关注的事情：大宗商品、它们如何在全球流动，以及如何定价。

value.zh: 工商管理学士：金融（国际贸易方向）+ 量化金融
玉米组，SMU 海事商人协会

description.en: Stalk to truck, elevator, ship and end use. Covers basis, storage carry, dry bulk ship sizes and the six main export routes.
description.zh: 从玉米秆到卡车、粮库、货轮和终端用途。涵盖基差、仓储价差、干散货船型和六大出口航线。

description.en: Wellhead to refinery: grades and differentials, tanker classes, chokepoints and the crack spread.
description.zh: 从井口到炼厂：油品等级与价差、油轮船型、海上咽喉要道和裂解价差。

description.en: Mine to cathode: concentrate, smelting charges (TC/RCs), warehouse stocks and demand from grids and EVs.
description.zh: 从矿山到阴极铜：精矿、加工费（TC/RC）、仓库库存，以及电网和电动车带来的需求。

text.en: I left China when I was two and grew up across East Africa and Southeast Asia. My story follows that route on a globe, one move at a time.
text.zh: 我两岁离开中国，在东非和东南亚长大。我的故事在地球仪上沿着这条路线，一站一站展开。

role.zh: 研究分析师，农业与谷物（玉米组）

description.en: Analysing price drivers, global trade flows and supply-demand balance sheets across the main origin and destination markets.
description.zh: 分析主要产地和消费市场的价格驱动因素、全球贸易流向和供需平衡表。

org.zh: 中国平安 · 金融壹账通

description.en: Pitched and translated live product demos for BNP Paribas executives, owned the ZhiNiao platform's pitch materials, and supported C-level consultations with Vingroup Vietnam.
description.zh: 为法国巴黎银行高管现场演示并翻译数字化产品，负责知鸟平台的路演材料，并协助与越南 Vingroup 的高层战略咨询。

description.en: Led a 12-person volunteer mission to an orphanage in Hebei and managed a SGD 15,000 budget with reporting to SMU and Wilmar.
description.zh: 带领 12 人志愿团队赴河北一所孤儿院开展项目，管理 15,000 新元预算，并向 SMU 和丰益汇报。

description.en: Built valuation and stress-test models for APAC solar, wind and storage assets, and a Java tool that standardised pricing and sensitivity models across teams.
description.zh: 为亚太地区的太阳能、风电和储能资产搭建估值与压力测试模型，并开发了一个 Java 工具，统一各团队的定价与敏感性模型。

text.en: I'm happy to talk about commodities, trading, internships or any of the projects here.
text.zh: 欢迎和我聊大宗商品、交易、实习机会，或这里的任何项目。
